content: OWASP Transaction Authorization guidance requires server-enforced permissions, allowed sequential transitions and final authorized execution. Lafu inference: hiding change buttons cannot enforce customer booking restrictions, and expired/cancelled bookings must reject stale approval or upload commands rather than revive places. Booking, payment and refund meanings should remain distinct. https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Transaction_Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html
